discription: A warm pad sound created with two detuned sine waves and a long release ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, detune=1.005, pan=0, gate=1; var sig1, sig2, sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 1.0, 0.7, 4.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig1 = SinOsc.ar(freq); sig2 = SinOsc.ar(freq * detune); sig = (sig1 + sig2) * 0.5; sig = Pan2.ar(sig * amp * env, pan); Out.ar(out, sig); }
